name: SimplePractice vs Valant
title: SimplePractice vs Valant: EHR Comparison for Psychiatrists & Therapists
description: Compare SimplePractice and Valant - two leading EHR platforms for behavioral health. See key differences in e-prescribing, pricing, features, and which is best for psychiatrists vs therapists.

summary.bottom_line: SimplePractice is ideal for solo therapists and wellness professionals seeking an affordable, user-friendly all-in-one platform, while Valant is purpose-built for psychiatrists and behavioral health practices needing robust e-prescribing with EPCS, outcome measurement, and psychiatric-specific workflows.

sections.heading: SimplePractice vs Valant: Overview
sections.content: SimplePractice and Valant serve different segments of the behavioral health market. SimplePractice is a popular all-in-one platform used by over 250,000 practitioners including therapists, counselors, nutritionists, and wellness professionals. Valant, founded by a psychiatrist in 2005, is purpose-built for behavioral health with features specifically designed for psychiatric practices including native e-prescribing with EPCS, PDMP integration, and outcome measurement tracking.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: SimplePractice offers transparent pricing starting at $49/month for solo practitioners, with Essential ($79/mo) and Plus ($99/mo) plans adding more features. Valant requires a custom quote with pricing typically ranging from $100-$300 per provider per month depending on practice size and features needed. SimplePractice's e-prescribing is an add-on ($49/mo + $89 setup), while Valant includes native e-prescribing with EPCS capabilities.

sections.heading: Key Feature Differences
sections.content: The most significant difference is e-prescribing: Valant offers native e-prescribing with EPCS for controlled substances and PDMP integration - critical for psychiatrists who prescribe. SimplePractice offers e-prescribing as an add-on. Valant also excels in outcome measurement with built-in PHQ-9, GAD-7, and other standardized assessments, while SimplePractice requires workarounds or add-ons. However, SimplePractice has better mobile apps and more calendar integrations.

sections.heading: Support & Implementation
sections.content: SimplePractice offers business hours support with extensive self-service resources and a 30-day free trial. Valant provides dedicated implementation support and training but does not offer a free trial. Valant's psychiatric-specific templates are designed by clinicians, while SimplePractice serves a broader audience with more general templates.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Your choice depends on whether you're a prescriber and your specific practice needs:

recommendations.when: You're a therapist, counselor, or non-prescribing clinician wanting an affordable, user-friendly platform with excellent mobile apps and broad calendar integrations
You're a psychiatrist, psychiatric NP, or prescriber needing native EPCS e-prescribing, PDMP integration, and psychiatric-specific workflows with built-in outcome measurement
You run an IOP/PHP program or community mental health center needing specialized program management features

faqs.q: Does Valant have better e-prescribing than SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Yes, Valant has native e-prescribing with EPCS (Electronic Prescribing for Controlled Substances) and PDMP integration built-in, making it better suited for psychiatrists. SimplePractice offers e-prescribing as an add-on ($49/month + $89 setup) but may have fewer psychiatric-specific features.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: SimplePractice or Valant?
faqs.a: SimplePractice is typically cheaper with transparent pricing starting at $49/month. Valant requires a custom quote and typically costs $100-$300 per provider per month. However, for psychiatrists needing e-prescribing, Valant's included EPCS may provide better value than SimplePractice's add-on pricing.

faqs.q: Is Valant or SimplePractice better for outcome tracking?
faqs.a: Valant has better built-in outcome measurement with standardized assessments like PHQ-9 and GAD-7 integrated into the workflow. SimplePractice has more limited measurement capabilities and may require add-ons or workarounds for comprehensive outcome tracking.

faqs.q: Does SimplePractice have a mobile app?
faqs.a: Yes, SimplePractice has mobile apps for both iOS and Android, allowing clinicians to manage their practice on the go. Valant does not have native mobile apps, which is a significant advantage for SimplePractice.
